estimand.target: conditional intention-to-treat effect of randomized targeting assignment on conversion

scope_separation.retrospective_audit: Re-evaluate the already observed 1%-2% pattern with paired simultaneous inference; no candidate selection or promotion is allowed.
scope_separation.synthetic_validation: Validate estimators and inference against known potential-outcome truth before any new real-data screen.
scope_separation.future_exploratory_screen: Requires a newly frozen data role or a new randomized campaign; existing Sprint 2 confirmation is forbidden.
scope_separation.future_confirmation: Requires a new randomized campaign and one business-selected hard budget locked before outcomes are read.

retrospective_audit.family_definition: all five registered challengers x two fold seeds x two budgets
retrospective_audit.inference: paired maximum-standardized bootstrap-deviation band over the full 20-cell family
retrospective_audit.decision_rule: diagnostic only; retain Response regardless of the retrospective interval

future_experiment_gate.selection_rule: maximize a simultaneous lower confidence bound over the frozen finite policy family; point estimates cannot select a winner

method_equivalences.racer_cmo: With the same cross-fitted mu0, mu1 and fixed propensity, the RCT CMO pseudo-outcome is algebraically identical to the existing doubly robust effect signal; do not add a duplicate learner.
method_equivalences.adjusted_signal: The pooled-outcome adjusted transformed signal remains unbiased but is auxiliary and is not the CMO variance-minimizer when propensity is 0.85.

model_workstreams.name: cross-fitted prognostic-causal hybrid logit
model_workstreams.hypothesis: Learn how much control-risk and DINA effect information to use, allowing the causal component to shrink to zero instead of imposing a hand-fixed residual weight.
model_workstreams.leakage_rule: Control-risk and CATE inputs to the stacker must be inner-OOF inside every outer training fold.

model_workstreams.name: prognostic pretraining for R-learner
model_workstreams.hypothesis: Use outcome-risk feature support as a soft prior for effect learning when prognostic and causal support overlap.
model_workstreams.mandatory_failure_case: Must not materially regress when prognostic and causal supports are disjoint.

model_workstreams.name: direct ranking forest
model_workstreams.hypothesis: A ranking objective may align training with allocation better than CATE MSE, but published evidence covers synthetic data and broader budgets rather than rare conversion at 1%-2%.
model_workstreams.extension_warning: Replacing whole-curve AUTOC with a 1%-2% objective is a new project hypothesis, not a reproduced theorem.

model_workstreams.name: rare-outcome class-flipping sensitivity
model_workstreams.hypothesis: A label-flipping transformation may stabilize modified-outcome training without changing population uplift up to a known scale; evaluation must always use untouched factual labels.

model_workstreams.name: relative-risk causal forest
model_workstreams.hypothesis: Use log-link relative-risk splitting as a heterogeneity diagnostic while still evaluating absolute ITT policy value.
